title: select 4plus choice list under 4
name: Select for 4+; choice list under 4 — Polaris
rule: Select for 4+ options; Choice list for <4.
pass_when: Fewer than 4 → choice list; 4+ → select (Polar named cutoffs).
fail_when: Polar surface uses select for <4 or choice list for a long 4+ set as if the Polar cutoff were ignored.
overview: Use Select for 4+ options; Choice list when there are fewer than four.
apply_when: Choosing Polaris Select versus Choice list for option count.
not_when: Select for under four options or Choice list for a long 4+ set.
agent_hint: Use Choice list under four options; use Select for four or more on Polar surfaces.
description: On Polar surfaces, use Select for 4+ options and Choice list for fewer than 4—the named Polar cutoffs. Pass when fewer than 4 map to choice list and 4+ map to select. Fail when a Polar surface uses select for under 4, or choice list for a long 4+ set, as if the Polar cutoff were ignored.
do_not_claim: A house number that beats NN/g handful / GOV.UK last-resort / USWDS <7 / M3 6 / Carbon 3. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.match_control_and_size`, `dropdown_chooser`, `combo_box`, `offer_choices_not_only_text`.
